newsitem.title: USA: Ford Credit launches new unit in Colorado.
newsitem.headline: Ford Credit launches new unit in Colorado.

text.p: Ford Motor Co's Ford Motor Credit Co said Tuesday it will launch a new non-prime automotive finance company that will generate 750 to 1,000 new jobs at its headquarters here over the next five years.
The new company, Fairlane Credit LLC, will open for business in late March 1997 and will become the first captive automotive financing company to enter the non-prime industry, Ford Credit said.
In addition to the 750 to 1,000 new jobs in Colorado Springs, Fairlane Credit also is expected to create additional jobs at other offices that will open across the United States.

Ford Credit said it has not yet found a suitable site for the Fairlane Credit headquarters. In a statement, the company added, "the support of state and local government, in particular the Greater Colorado Springs Economic Development Corporation, has been instrumental in our decision to come to Colorado Springs."
Most of the new employees will be recruited from the greater Colorado Springs area, Ford Credit said.
